summary.intent: Fix a failing vault recovery E2E test in CI, then address a series of CI/CD infrastructure issues (Grafana auth, Tauri signing, desktop build workflow), fix additional E2E test failures for writable shares, and update project documentation for milestone v1.1 completion.
summary.outcome: All target bugs were fixed and merged: protobuf field number bug in IPNS parsing, IPNS resolution order, response body double-consume, Tauri action version, writable shares file-ipns key ID mismatch, and throttler bypass for test mode. Codebase docs were fully rewritten for the multi-package architecture and a feature matrix plus deferred items inventory were created.

repo: IPNS record value is protobuf field 1, not field 2 — field 2 is signatureV1. The extractCidFromIpnsRecord function had this wrong.
Delegated routing should be attempted before IPFS gateway HEAD checks — gateway can hang 15-30s when Kubo can't resolve mock-published IPNS names, while delegated routing resolves instantly.
Standalone file shares create a synthetic FilePointer with id=shareId, but file-ipns keys are stored with itemId=fileId (the real file UUID), causing IPNS key lookup mismatches on shared file edits.
ThrottlerModule limits are hardcoded and not affected by NODE_ENV — needed to convert to forRootAsync with ConfigService to relax limits in test mode.
tauri-apps/tauri-action@v1 does not exist — only @v0 (current v0.6.2) is published. The staging workflow correctly used @v0 but build-desktop.yml referenced the non-existent v1.
Grafana Cloud /api/health returns 404 (not 401/403) when an invalid or expired Bearer token is provided, making expired service account tokens hard to diagnose.
The Tauri auto-updater endpoint /releases/latest/ only resolves non-prerelease GitHub releases — staging releases marked prerelease:true are invisible to the updater.
create-desktop-release job creates release with --prerelease flag but tauri-action then sets prerelease:false, causing inconsistency — both must match.
includeUpdaterJson is not set by default in tauri-action — must be explicitly enabled to generate latest.json for the auto-updater.

code.finding: extractCidFromIpnsRecord checked fieldNumber === 2 (signatureV1) instead of fieldNumber === 1 (value) — root cause of all IPNS resolution failures in recovery
resp.json() was called to parse protobuf response, then resp.arrayBuffer() was called in fallthrough — double body consume bug
Backoff retry only triggered on thrown errors, not on non-OK responses (429/5xx) — added !resp.ok check with sleep before retry
Standalone file share creates fake FilePointer with id: shareItem.share.shareId, but file-ipns key stored with itemId: fileId (real UUID) — getFileIpnsKeyFn lookup fails due to ID mismatch
Added fallback for standalone file shares: if exact itemId match fails AND shareItem.share.itemType === 'file', use first file-ipns key — safe because standalone shares have exactly one file
ThrottlerModule converted from forRoot (hardcoded limits) to forRootAsync with ConfigService to allow NODE_ENV=test to relax throttling to 200/sec and 2000/min
Test timeout was 30s — same as IPFS gateway timeout — meaning gateway hang consumed the entire test budget before delegated routing fallback could run

After textarea.fill(), React's onChange fires asynchronously — pressing Ctrl+S immediately after had isDirty=false in stale closure, skipping save. Fix: wait for modified status indicator before sending keypress

workflow: Always run E2E tests locally with NODE_ENV=test on the API before committing to avoid CI round-trips — throttler limits cause account creation 429s in development mode.
When diagnosing 'recovery-progress-log is empty' in E2E — check IPNS resolution order and protobuf parsing before assuming network issues.
Playwright test suites interfere with each other when run concurrently against a shared API/DB — run suites sequentially or use isolated test accounts.
Killing Playwright processes mid-run can terminate the web dev server if it was launched as a child process — check service health after cleanup.
Git worktrees should be cleaned up before switching to docs/cleanup branches to avoid stale references.

friction: Multiple CI round-trips for E2E test fixes before establishing local test infrastructure with NODE_ENV=test — user explicitly asked to stop this pattern.
1Password SSH agent not accessible from subprocess during git commits, blocking commit signing in some contexts.
Background Playwright runs competed with foreground runs for shared API/DB resources, causing false failures.
Docker Hub unauthorized errors on CI causing cascading failures across all postgres-dependent jobs (transient infrastructure issue).
git index.lock file left from previous process prevented git switch/pull operations.
Playwright kill also terminated the web dev server, breaking subsequent test runs.
CodeRabbit review comments required 3 separate resolve-reviews invocations across PRs 369, 375, and 376.
tauri-action v1 startup_failure surfaced only on release events, not in PR checks — silent until a real release was tagged.
